project.title: dot_matrix_animated_counter
project.tagline: Animated dot-matrix counters for Flutter with controller-driven updates and flexible theming.

summary.short: dot_matrix_animated_counter is a Flutter package for animated dot-matrix numeric counters with controller-based updates, ThemeExtension styling, multiple transition styles, negative values, and grouping support.
summary.long: The package supports fadeScale, slide, and flip transitions, configurable digit formatting, zero padding, grouping separators, local or app-wide theming, and a published web demo.

highlights: Negative values, zero padding, and grouping
